title: Household Water Conservation
publisher: Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti
summary: The National Water Mission identifies water conservation and minimising wastage as central objectives.

sections.heading: Household conservation principle
sections.content: Using water carefully and avoiding unnecessary wastage aligns with these water-conservation objectives. This document provides general principles only and does not set local requirements.

sections.heading: Citizen action
sections.content: The Mission includes promotion of citizen and state action for water conservation, augmentation, and preservation.

scope: General household water conservation principles only; no local requirements or numerical targets.
verificationNotes: Reviewed against the official National Water Mission page on 2026-08-08.
